title: Plugin Conversion
meta: Clearer onboarding, upgrade prompts and calls to action that turn plugin installs into active stores. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: WooCommerce plugin conversion, from install to active store
overview: A free plugin only earns when stores finish setup and upgrade. We install your plugin as a new store owner would and note where people stall. Then we improve the first-run notice, setup wizard, settings wording and upgrade screens, and add simple usage tracking that asks for consent. We keep prompts respectful and follow WordPress.org rules on notices and upsells.

faq: Can you promise more upgrades to Pro?
No. Results depend on your plugin, audience and pricing. We remove friction we can see, add tracking so you can measure it and report honestly on what the numbers show.
In a limited way. The guidelines forbid nagging and misleading notices, so we keep prompts dismissible, calm and placed where they make sense, and avoid anything that could put your listing at risk.
Only with clear opt-in. We add a plain-language consent notice, send only the data you list and never collect personal customer data. You get the wording for your privacy page.
Does this work for a paid plugin sold outside WordPress.org?
Yes. The same onboarding and upgrade ideas apply, and the rules are looser. We still keep the experience respectful, because store owners notice pushy prompts and uninstall.
